description: „Shiny And New” is the fifth release from Mocky’s Single Series on his own Heavy Sheet label - this time featuring Stones Throw Records artist Benny Sings. It‘s a song that seems to want to make the summer last just one more week, with Benny gliding nostalgically over the throwback lofi-funk soundtrack and Mocky popping in for the odd vocal cameo. Fans of Benny Sings might remember this vocal pairing from the last times the two were on record together when Mocky featured on Benny’s songs “Duplicate” and “Beat 100”. Here Benny returns the favor with his signature style and smooth delivery and Mocky’s production keeps us bouncing effortlessly until we hit that repeat button .. one .. more .. time.
credits:
Vocals by Benny Sings, Background Vocals by Mocky
All instruments played and recorded by Mocky
Produced by Mocky
Written by Dominic "Mocky" Salole and Benny Sings
Published by Heavy Sheet Music/Warner Chappell, Soepermarkt Music/Pennies From Heaven
